summary: From a nonzero form majorant, near positions for p and for q (shifted by y and y·x); the minors of the frame data give units β, γ controlling the partial products of p and q; the gauge of depth α = gβ̄γ̄βγ makes p, q heads and the head weights √[β]^K, √[γ]^K.

steps.claim: g ∈ R, W_Z cut, and points y, x with near positions σ, τ for p and q (from the nonzero majorant).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨g, c, x, y, ⟨σ, hσ, a⟩, τ, hτ, b⟩ := h.integral_data.2.2.1, isCut_besselVector Z,
    e.imp fun _ e ↦ (exists_ne_zero_of_ae ae_stackMeasure_mem e).imp fun _ k ↦
    (mul_ne_zero_iff.1 k.2).imp exists_ne_zero_of_pivotModulus exists_ne_zero_of_pivotModulus

steps.claim: For a sequence p and a near position: a unit β with β ∈ R, β/∏_{a<l}p_a ∈ R (l ≤ j), β/p_i ∈ R (i < j), and finHeadWeight(K, j, p) = √[β]^K (from the sizes of the minors).
steps.lean:
have H p y a b : ∃ β : Aˣ, ((β.1 ∈ R ∧ ∀ l ≤ j, (β / ∏ a ∈ .range l, p a).1 ∈ R) ∧ ∀ i < j,
      (β / p i).1 ∈ R) ∧ finHeadWeight K j p = √(_root_.genIndex β.1) ^ K := have H :=
      (minors_mem_ofSize (p := p) h.gauge.hasMatSize_box hj ((c.isNear_of_ne_zero
      b).of_floorGroup_mul hτ) ((c.isNear_of_ne_zero a).of_floorGroup_mul (g := y) hσ).choose_spec)
    ⟨∏ l ∈ .range (j + 1), ∏ a ∈ .range l, p a, suffices _ from ⟨this, fun i l ↦ by
        simpa [prod_range_succ, div_eq_mul_inv, -Units.coe_prod] using mul_mem (this.2 _ l) (H
        i l.le)⟩; by simp_all [← prod_erase_eq_div], by clear * - H; induction j <;> simp_all
      [finHeadWeight, prod_range_succ _ (_ + 1), prod_range_succ (M := ℝ), ← Units.coe_prod]⟩
steps.typed_fact:
∃ β : Aˣ, ((β.1 ∈ R ∧ ∀ l ≤ j, (β / ∏ a ∈ .range l, p a).1 ∈ R) ∧ ∀ i < j,
      (β / p i).1 ∈ R) ∧ finHeadWeight K j p = √(_root_.genIndex β.1) ^ K

steps.claim: it suffices to prove the integrality conditions, from which the remaining one follows by multiplying;
steps.lean:
suffices _ from ⟨this, fun i l ↦ by
        simpa [prod_range_succ, div_eq_mul_inv, -Units.coe_prod] using mul_mem (this.2 _ l) (H
        i l.le)⟩; by simp_all [← prod_erase_eq_div],

steps.claim: the head weight identity by induction on j.
steps.lean:
by clear * - H; induction j <;> simp_all
      [finHeadWeight, prod_range_succ _ (_ + 1), prod_range_succ (M := ℝ), ← Units.coe_prod]⟩

steps.claim: Take β for p (at y), γ for q (at yx); α = g·conj(βγ)·βγ; it is self-conjugate and in R; the head, size and Λ conditions remain.
steps.lean:
refine (H p y ?_ ?_).elim fun β ⟨u, _⟩ ↦ (H q (y * x) ?_ ?_).elim fun γ ⟨v, _⟩ ↦
    ⟨F.g * star (β * γ) * β * γ, ?_, by simp [star_g]; ring, ?_, ?_, fun E _ ↦ ?_⟩

steps.claim: The self-conjugacy and the Weyl-element commutation.
Unfold IsHead and the sizes; md and genIndex: md(u)⁻¹ = √[u]².
steps.lean: all_goals simp [IsHead, *, div_eq_mul_inv, ENNReal.mul_inv, inv_md_eq_sqrt_genIndex_sq, mul_sub]

steps.lean:
